entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, how's it going? You getting any[n]better at remembering how to handle[n]different bean types?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Now then... there are three factors that[n]determine the flavor for a cup of coffee:[n]grind, heat, and time.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: First up is the grind. For the siphons we have[n]here, we're aiming for medium-fine.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Are you listening to me? What[n]grind are you supposed to use?
Medium-fine.[clr 27]
Coarse.
Anything goes.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Right. Keep up the good work.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't give me that half-assed crap.[n]I just said, it's medium-fine.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll toss you out if you keep that attitude up.[n]I just said, it's supposed to be medium-fine.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It doesn't net much profit given the effort[n]it takes, but hey, money is money.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm not gonna forgive you if you[n]serve our customers crap coffee[n]though. Just remember that.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Who could this be...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yes, hello?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...How'd you get this number?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Now? Where?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Fine.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sorry, something just came up.[n]We can keep going with the[n]lessons some other time.
Is it a date?
Is it trouble?[clr 27]
You don't want my help anymore?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If only.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What, you worried about me?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...It's nothing you need[n]to concern yourself over.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Of course I do. Like I[n]said, we'll continue later.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Just do the dishes while I'm gone.[n]Oh, and remember to shut off the[n]gas before you close up shop.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's nice having someone around[n]to help at times like this.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Turns out you're actually a harder[n]worker than I thought. Keep it up.
I feel like my bond with[n]Sojiro is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Okay, I'm off. Don't eat all[n]our food while I'm gone.
